static SpallProfile spall_profile;
static SpallBuffer spall_buffer;
static HANDLE spall_file;
static void spall_begin(char *name)
{

    spall_buffer_begin(&spall_profile, &spall_buffer, name, cstring_length(name), get_time_us());
}
static void spall_end()
{
    spall_buffer_end(&spall_profile, &spall_buffer, get_time_us());
}
__attribute__((no_instrument_function)) _Bool spall_callback_write(SpallProfile *sp, const void *data, size_t length)
{
    return WriteFile(spall_file, data, length, 0, 0);
}
__attribute__((no_instrument_function)) _Bool spall_callback_flush(SpallProfile *sp)
{
    return 1;
}
__attribute__((no_instrument_function)) void spall_callback_close(SpallProfile *sp)
{
    if(!(CloseHandle(spall_file))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };
}
static void spall_begin_profiling()
{
    spall_file = CreateFileA("profile.spall",
        (0x40000000L) | ( 0x0004 ),
        0x00000001,
        0,
        2,
        0x00000080,
        0);

    if(!(spall_file)) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };

    spall_init_callbacks(1000, &spall_callback_write, &spall_callback_flush, &spall_callback_close, 0, &spall_profile);

    u64 buffer_size = (((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024);
    void *mem;
    mem_reserve(buffer_size, &mem);
    mem_commit(mem, buffer_size);
    memset(mem, 'd', buffer_size);
    spall_buffer = (SpallBuffer)
    {
        .length = buffer_size,
        .data = mem
    };
    if(!(spall_buffer_init(&spall_profile, &spall_buffer))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };
}
static void spall_end_profiling()
{
    spall_buffer_quit(&spall_profile, &spall_buffer);
    mem_free(spall_buffer.data);
    spall_quit(&spall_profile);
}







static arena *arena_alloc(u64 reserve, u64 commit)
{


    u64 reserve_size = (reserve + 4096) / 4096 * 4096;
    u64 commit_size = (commit + 4096) / 4096 * 4096;

    void *base;

    mem_reserve(reserve_size, &base);
    mem_commit(base, commit_size);

    arena *header = base;

    header->reserved = reserve_size;
    header->commited = commit_size;
    header->used = sizeof(arena_t);
    header->base = base;



    return header;
}

static void *arena_push_noalign(arena *arena, u64 size)
{
    void *ptr = (void*)((u8*)arena->base + arena->used);

    arena->used += size;

    if(!(arena->reserved >= arena->used)) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };

    if(arena->commited < arena->used)
    {
        spall_begin("arena commit");





        u64 commitSize = (arena->used + 4096) / 4096 * 4096;

        arena->commited = commitSize;

        mem_commit(arena -> base, commitSize);
        spall_end();;
    }

                                   ;

    return ptr;
}

static void *arena_push(arena *arena, u64 size, u64 align)
{
    u32 rem = (64 + arena->used) % align;
    u32 padding = rem == 0 ? 0 : align - rem;
    u8 *mem = arena_push_noalign(arena, padding + size);
    return mem + padding;
}

static void arena_reset(arena *arena)
{
    arena->used = sizeof(arena_t);


}

static void arena_release(arena *arena)
{
    mem_free(arena->base);
}






static void win32_assert()
{
    u32 error = GetLastError();

    if(error == 0)
    {

    }
    else
    {
        void* message = 0;

        FormatMessageA(0x00000100 |
                      0x00001000 |
                      0x00000200,
                      ((void*)0),
                      error,
                      ((((WORD )(0x01)) << 10) | (WORD )(0x00)),
                      (LPTSTR) &message, 0,0);

        if(!(0)) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };
    }
}

static void d3d11_write_buffer(ID3D11Resource *buffer, void *data, u64 size)
{
    D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mapped;
    ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> Map(device_context,buffer,0,D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD,0,&mapped) );
    memcpy(mapped.pData, data, size);
    ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> Unmap(device_context,buffer,0) );
}

static void *win32_read_file(char *path, u32 *out_size, arena_t *arena)
{

    HANDLE fileHandle = CreateFileA(path,
                        (0x80000000L),
                        0x00000001,
                        0,
                        3,
                        0x00000080,
                        0);
    win32_assert();
    u32 size = GetFileSize(fileHandle, 0 );

    if(out_size)
    {
        *out_size = size;
    }

    if(!(size != 0)) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };
    void *buffer = arena_push(arena, size, 64);
    win32_assert();

    ReadFile(fileHandle,
             buffer,
             size,
             0,
             0);
    win32_assert();

    CloseHandle(fileHandle);
    return buffer;
}

static loaded_bitmap load_bitmap(char *path, arena_t *arena)
{
    void *file = win32_read_file(path, 0, arena);

    loaded_bitmap bitmap = { 0 };
    bitmap.header = (bitmap_header*)file;
    bitmap.data = ((u8*)file) + bitmap.header->BitmapOffset;


    if(!(bitmap.header->Compression == 3)) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };


    u32 num_pixels = bitmap.header->Width * bitmap.header->Height;
    for(u32 i = 0; i < num_pixels; i++)
    {
        u8* ptr = ((u8*)bitmap.data) + i * 4;

        u8 b = *(ptr + 0);
        u8 g = *(ptr + 1);
        u8 r = *(ptr + 2);
        u8 a = *(ptr + 3);

        *(ptr + 0) = r;
        *(ptr + 1) = g;
        *(ptr + 2) = b;
        *(ptr + 3) = a;
    }

    return bitmap;
}


static void toggle_fullscreen()
{


    u64 dwStyle = GetWindowLongA(window, (-16));

    if (dwStyle & (0x00000000L | 0x00C00000L | 0x00080000L | 0x00040000L | 0x00020000L | 0x00010000L))
    {
        MONITORINFO mi = { sizeof(mi) };

        if (GetWindowPlacement(window, &windowedPlacement)
            && GetMonitorInfoA(MonitorFromWindow(window, 0x00000001), &mi))
        {

            SetWindowLongA(window, (-16), dwStyle & ~(0x00000000L | 0x00C00000L | 0x00080000L | 0x00040000L | 0x00020000L | 0x00010000L));
            SetWindowPos(window, ((HWND)0),
                        mi.rcMonitor.left, mi.rcMonitor.top,
                        mi.rcMonitor.right - mi.rcMonitor.left,
                        mi.rcMonitor.bottom - mi.rcMonitor.top,
                        0x0200 | 0x0020);
        }
    }
    else
    {

        SetWindowLongA(window, (-16), dwStyle | (0x00000000L | 0x00C00000L | 0x00080000L | 0x00040000L | 0x00020000L | 0x00010000L));
        SetWindowPlacement(window, &windowedPlacement);
        SetWindowPos(window, ((void*)0), 0, 0, 0, 0,
                 0x0002 | 0x0001 | 0x0004 |
                 0x0200 | 0x0020);
    }
}

static input_event input_queue[128];
static u32 input_queue_count;

LRESULT window_callback(HWND window,
    UINT message,
    WPARAM wParam,
    LPARAM lParam)
{
    stbsp_sprintf(buf, "msg 0x%04X\n", message);
    spall_begin(buf);
    LRESULT result = 0;
    switch (message)
    {
        case 0x0104:
        case 0x0105:
        case 0x0101:
        case 0x0100:
        {
            b32 was_down = (lParam & (1 << 30));
            b32 is_down = !(lParam & (1 << 31));

            u16 code = (u8)wParam;

            if(GetKeyState(0x10) & 0x8000)
            {
                code |= MODIFIER_SHIFT;
            }

            if(GetKeyState(0x11) & 0x8000)
            {
                code |= MODIFIER_CTRL;
            }

            if(GetKeyState(0x12) & 0x8000)
            {
                code |= MODIFIER_ALT;
            }

            input_queue[input_queue_count] = (input_event)
            {
                .type = INPUT_EVENT_KEY,
                .code = code,
                .is_repeat = was_down && is_down,
                .is_down = is_down
            };
            input_queue_count++;
            break;
        }
        case 0x0102:
        {
            input_queue[input_queue_count] = (input_event)
            {
                .type = INPUT_EVENT_TEXT,
                .character = wParam
            };
            input_queue_count++;
            break;
        }
        case 0x020A:
        {
            mouse_wheel_delta_accum += (i16)(wParam >> 16);

            break;
        }
        case 0x0200:
        {
            mouse_x = ((WORD)(((DWORD_PTR)(lParam)) & 0xffff));
            mouse_y = ((WORD)((((DWORD_PTR)(lParam)) >> 16) & 0xffff));
            break;
        }
        case 0x0005:
        {
            if(wParam == 1)
            {

                break;
            }

            new_screen_w = (i32) ((WORD)(((DWORD_PTR)(lParam)) & 0xffff));
            new_screen_h = (i32) ((WORD)((((DWORD_PTR)(lParam)) >> 16) & 0xffff));

            if(!(new_screen_w != 0)) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };
            if(!(new_screen_h != 0)) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };
            break;
        }
        case 0x0010:
        {
            DestroyWindow(window);
            break;
        }
        case 0x0002:
        {
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            break;
        }
        default:
        {
            result = DefWindowProcA(window, message, wParam, lParam);
            break;
        }
    }
    spall_end();;
    return result;
}

static ID3D11ShaderResourceView *d3d11_upload_bitmap(loaded_bitmap bitmap)
{
    ID3D11ShaderResourceView* texture_view;
    D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC texture_desc =
    {
        .Width = bitmap.header->Width,
        .Height = bitmap.header->Width,
        .MipLevels = 1,
        .ArraySize = 1,
        .Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
        .SampleDesc = { 1, 0 },
        .Usage = D3D11_USAGE_IMMUTABLE,
        .BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE,
    };

    D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA texture_data =
    {
        .pSysMem = bitmap.data,
        .SysMemPitch = bitmap.header->Height * sizeof(u32),
    };

    ID3D11Texture2D* texture;
    ( (device)->lpVtbl -> CreateTexture2D(device,&texture_desc,&texture_data,&texture) );
    ( (device)->lpVtbl -> CreateShaderResourceView(device,(ID3D11Resource*)texture,((void*)0),&texture_view) );
    ( (texture)->lpVtbl -> Release(texture) );
    return texture_view;
}

static void resize_swapchain()
{
    if(rt_view)
    {
        ( (rt_view)->lpVtbl -> Release(rt_view) );
        ( (uav)->lpVtbl -> Release(uav) );
        rt_view = 0;
    }


    HRESULT hr = ( (swapchain)->lpVtbl -> ResizeBuffers(swapchain,0,screen_w,screen_h,DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN,swapchain_flags) );
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };


    ID3D11Texture2D* backbuffer;
    ( (swapchain)->lpVtbl -> GetBuffer(swapchain,0,&IID_ID3D11Texture2D,(void**)&backbuffer) );
    ( (device)->lpVtbl -> CreateRenderTargetView(device,(ID3D11Resource*)backbuffer,((void*)0),&rt_view) );
    ( (backbuffer)->lpVtbl -> Release(backbuffer) );
    ( (device)->lpVtbl -> CreateUnorderedAccessView(device,(ID3D11Resource*)backbuffer,0,&uav) );
    ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> CSSetUnorderedAccessViews(device_context,0,1,&uav,0) );
}

static void busy_wait(u64 time_us)
{
    u64 a = get_time_us() + time_us;
    while(get_time_us() < a) { }
}

static u32 caret_get_column(caret *caret)
{
    for(u32 i = caret->position; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        if(i == 0)
        {
            return caret->position - i;
        }
        if(text[i] == '\n')
        {
            return caret->position - i - 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static void merge_overlapping_carets_in_a_slow_way()
{
    u32 n = 0;
    for(u32 i = 0; i < num_carets; i++)
    {
        b32 overlapped = 0;
        for(i32 j = n; j >= 0; j--)
        {
            if(i != j && carets[i].position == carets[j].position)
            {
                overlapped = 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        if(!overlapped)
        {
            carets[n] = carets[i];
            n++;
        }
    }
    num_carets = n;
}

static void caret_move_right(caret *caret)
{
    u32 p = caret->position;
    while(caret->position != text_size)
    {
        char c = text[caret->position];
        caret->position++;
        if(c == '\n')
        {
            break;
        }
        if(c > 31)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    caret->wish_column = caret_get_column(caret);
    caret_last_move_time = frame_start;
}

static void caret_move_left(caret *caret)
{
    while(caret->position)
    {
        caret->position--;
        char c = text[caret->position];
        if(c == '\r')
        {
            break;
        }
        if(c > 31)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    caret->wish_column = caret_get_column(caret);
    caret_last_move_time = frame_start;
}

static void caret_move_to_prev_line(caret *caret)
{
    while(caret->position)
    {
        if(text[caret->position] == '\n')
        {
            caret->position--;
            break;
        }
        caret->position--;
    }
}

static void caret_move_to_line_start(caret *caret)
{
    while(1)
    {
        if(caret->position == 0 || text[caret->position - 1] == '\n')
        {
            break;
        }
        caret->position--;
    }
}

static void caret_go_to_column(caret *caret, u32 col)
{
    caret_move_to_line_start(caret);
    u32 c = 0;
    while(c != col && caret->position != text_size)
    {
        if(text[caret->position] == '\r')
        {
            break;
        }
        caret->position++;
        c++;
    }
}

static void caret_move_to_next_line(caret *caret)
{
    while(caret->position != text_size)
    {
        if(text[caret->position] == '\n')
        {
            caret->position++;
            break;
        }
        caret->position++;
    }
}

static void caret_move_up(caret *caret)
{
    caret_move_to_prev_line(caret);
    caret_go_to_column(caret, caret->wish_column);
    caret_last_move_time = frame_start;
}

static void caret_move_down(caret *caret)
{
    caret_move_to_next_line(caret);
    caret_go_to_column(caret, caret->wish_column);
    caret_last_move_time = frame_start;
}

static void carets_bubble_sort_top_to_bottom()
{
    for(;;)
    {
        u32 num_swaps = 0;
        for(u32 i = 0; i < num_carets - 1; i++)
        {
            caret a = carets[i];
            caret b = carets[i + 1];
            if(a.position > b.position)
            {
                carets[i] = b;
                carets[i + 1] = a;
                num_swaps++;
            }
        }
        if(num_swaps == 0)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
}

static void undo_buffer_push(undo_buffer_entry *entry)
{
    if(undo_buffer_position)
    {
        undo_buffer_position->next = entry;
        entry->prev = undo_buffer_position;
        undo_buffer_position = entry;
    }
    else
    {
        undo_buffer_position = entry;
        undo_buffer_tail = entry;
    }
}

static void carets_insert_characters(text_edit_insert insert, b32 write_undo)
{
    carets_bubble_sort_top_to_bottom();
    u32 offset = 0;
    for(u32 c = 0; c < num_carets; c++)
    {
        string s = insert.strings[0];
        caret *caret = &carets[c];
        if(s.length)
        {
            caret->position += offset;
            offset += s.length;
            u32 p = caret->position;
            for(u32 i = text_size + s.length - 1; i >= p + s.length; i--)
            {
                text[i] = text[i - s.length];
            }
            for(u32 i = 0; i < s.length; i++)
            {
                text[p + i] = s.p[i];
            }
            text_size += s.length;
            caret->position += s.length;
        }
        caret->wish_column = caret_get_column(caret);
    }
    if(write_undo)
    {
        undo_buffer_entry *e = (arena_push(undo_buffer_arena, sizeof(undo_buffer_entry), 8));
        *e = (undo_buffer_entry)
        {
            .kind = TEXT_EDIT_INSERT,
            .carets = (memcpy(arena_push(undo_buffer_arena, sizeof(caret) * num_carets, 8), carets, sizeof(caret) * num_carets)),
            .num_carets = num_carets
        };
        e->strings = arena_push(undo_buffer_arena, num_carets * sizeof(string), 8);
        for(u32 i = 0; i < num_carets; i++)
        {
            e->strings[i].length = insert.strings[i].length;
            e->strings[i].p = (memcpy(arena_push(undo_buffer_arena, insert.strings[i].length, 8), insert.strings[i].p, insert.strings[i].length));
        }
        undo_buffer_push(e);
    }
}


static void carets_remove_characters(text_edit_delete delete, b32 write_undo)
{
    undo_buffer_entry *e = (arena_push(undo_buffer_arena, sizeof(undo_buffer_entry), 8));
    if(write_undo)
    {
        *e = (undo_buffer_entry)
        {
            .kind = TEXT_EDIT_DELETE,
            .strings = (memset(arena_push(undo_buffer_arena, sizeof(string) * num_carets, 8), 0, sizeof(string) * num_carets)),
            .num_carets = num_carets,
        };
    }
    carets_bubble_sort_top_to_bottom();
    u32 offset = 0;
    for(u32 c = 0; c < num_carets; c++)
    {
        caret *caret = &carets[c];
        caret->position -= offset;
        u32 num_to_remove = (((delete.lengths[c]) < (caret->position)) ? (delete.lengths[c]) : (caret->position));

        if(caret->position >= num_to_remove + 1)
        {
            if(text[caret->position - num_to_remove] == '\n' &&
                text[caret->position - num_to_remove - 1] == '\r')
            {
                num_to_remove++;
            }
        }
        if(write_undo)
        {
            e->strings[c].p = (memcpy(arena_push(undo_buffer_arena, num_to_remove, 8), text + caret->position - num_to_remove, num_to_remove));
            e->strings[c].length = num_to_remove;
        }
        offset += num_to_remove;
        for(u32 i = caret->position - num_to_remove; i < text_size; i++)
        {
            text[i] = text[i + num_to_remove];
        }
        text_size -= num_to_remove;
        caret->position -= num_to_remove;
        caret->wish_column = caret_get_column(caret);
    }
    if(write_undo)
    {
        e->carets = (memcpy(arena_push(undo_buffer_arena, sizeof(caret) * num_carets, 8), carets, sizeof(caret) * num_carets)),
        undo_buffer_push(e);
    }
}

static void caret_spawn_new_below()
{
    caret bottom_caret = carets[0];
    for(u32 i = 0; i < num_carets; i++)
    {
        if(carets[i].position > bottom_caret.position)
        {
            bottom_caret = carets[i];
        }
    }
    carets[num_carets] = bottom_caret;
    caret_move_down(&carets[num_carets]);
    num_carets++;
}

static void caret_spawn_new_above()
{
    caret top_caret = carets[0];
    for(u32 i = 0; i < num_carets; i++)
    {
        if(carets[i].position < top_caret.position)
        {
            top_caret = carets[i];
        }
    }
    carets[num_carets] = top_caret;
    caret_move_up(&carets[num_carets]);
    num_carets++;
}
# 911 "editor.c"
static void undo()
{
    undo_buffer_entry *entry = undo_buffer_position;
    if(entry)
    {
        switch(entry->kind)
        {
            case TEXT_EDIT_DELETE:
            {
                memcpy(carets, entry->carets, sizeof(caret) * entry->num_carets);
                num_carets = entry->num_carets;
                text_edit_insert insert =
                {
                    .strings = entry->strings,
                };
                carets_insert_characters(insert, 0);
                break;
            }
            case TEXT_EDIT_INSERT:
            {
                memcpy(carets, entry->carets, sizeof(caret) * entry->num_carets);
                num_carets = entry->num_carets;
                u32 *lengths = arena_push(frame_arena, sizeof(u32) * entry->num_carets, 8);
                for(u32 i = 0; i < entry->num_carets; i++)
                {
                    lengths[i] = entry->strings[i].length;
                }
                text_edit_delete delete =
                {
                    .lengths = lengths,
                };
                carets_remove_characters(delete, 0);
                break;
            }
        }
        undo_buffer_position = entry->prev;
    }
}

static void redo()
{
    if(undo_buffer_position)
    {
        if(undo_buffer_position->next)
        {
            undo_buffer_position = undo_buffer_position->next;
        }
        else
        {
            return;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        undo_buffer_position = undo_buffer_tail;
    }
    undo_buffer_entry *entry = undo_buffer_position;
    if(entry)
    {
        switch(entry->kind)
        {
            case TEXT_EDIT_DELETE:
            {
                memcpy(carets, entry->carets, sizeof(caret) * entry->num_carets);
                num_carets = entry->num_carets;
                u32 *lengths = arena_push(frame_arena, sizeof(u32) * entry->num_carets, 8);
                for(u32 i = 0; i < entry->num_carets; i++)
                {
                    lengths[i] = entry->strings[i].length;
                }
                text_edit_delete delete =
                {
                    .lengths = lengths,
                };
                u32 offset = 0;
                for(u32 i = 0; i < num_carets; i++)
                {
                    offset += entry->strings[i].length;
                    carets[i].position += offset;
                }
                carets_remove_characters(delete, 0);
                break;
            }
            case TEXT_EDIT_INSERT:
            {
                memcpy(carets, entry->carets, sizeof(caret) * entry->num_carets);
                num_carets = entry->num_carets;
                u32 offset = 0;
                for(u32 i = 0; i < num_carets; i++)
                {
                    offset += entry->strings[i].length;
                    carets[i].position -= offset;
                }
                text_edit_insert insert =
                {
                    .strings = entry->strings,
                };
                carets_insert_characters(insert, 0);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

void __stdcall WinMainCRTStartup()
{
    QueryPerformanceFrequency((LARGE_INTEGER*)&perf_counter_freq);


    spall_begin_profiling();


    spall_begin("startup");

    HMODULE hModule = GetModuleHandleA(0);
    HRESULT hr;
    WNDCLASS windowClass = {0};

    windowClass.style = 0x0020 | 0x0002 | 0x0001;
    windowClass.lpfnWndProc = window_callback;
    windowClass.hInstance = hModule;
    windowClass.hCursor = LoadCursorA(0, ((LPSTR)((ULONG_PTR)((WORD)(32512)))));
    windowClass.hbrBackground = 0;
    windowClass.lpszClassName = "balls";
    windowClass.hIcon = LoadIconA(hModule, ((LPSTR)((ULONG_PTR)((WORD)(1)))));

    RegisterClassA(&windowClass);

    new_screen_w = 800;
    new_screen_h = 600;

    window = CreateWindowExA(
        0x00040000L | 0x00200000L,
        windowClass.lpszClassName,
        "editor",
        (0x00000000L | 0x00C00000L | 0x00080000L | 0x00040000L | 0x00020000L | 0x00010000L),
        ((int)0x80000000),
        ((int)0x80000000),
        new_screen_w,
        new_screen_h,
        0,
        0,
        hModule,
        0);
    if(!(window)) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };

    D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL levels[] =
    {
        D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0
    };

    u32 flags = D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_SINGLETHREADED;


    flags |= D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_DEBUG;


    hr = D3D11CreateDevice(0,
        D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE,
        0,
        flags,
        levels,
        (sizeof(levels) / sizeof(levels[0])),
        ( 7 ),
        &device,
        0,
        &device_context);
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };



    {
        ID3D11InfoQueue* info;
        ( (device)->lpVtbl -> QueryInterface(device,&IID_ID3D11InfoQueue,(void**)&info) );
        ( (info)->lpVtbl -> SetBreakOnSeverity(info,D3D11_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_CORRUPTION,1) );
        ( (info)->lpVtbl -> SetBreakOnSeverity(info,D3D11_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR,1) );
        ( (info)->lpVtbl -> Release(info) );
    }


    {
        IDXGIInfoQueue* dxgiInfo;
        HRESULT hr;
        hr = DXGIGetDebugInterface1(0, &IID_IDXGIInfoQueue, (void**)&dxgiInfo);
        if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };
        ( (dxgiInfo)->lpVtbl -> SetBreakOnSeverity(dxgiInfo,DXGI_DEBUG_ALL,DXGI_INFO_QUEUE_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_CORRUPTION,1) );
        ( (dxgiInfo)->lpVtbl -> SetBreakOnSeverity(dxgiInfo,DXGI_DEBUG_ALL,DXGI_INFO_QUEUE_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR,1) );
        ( (dxgiInfo)->lpVtbl -> Release(dxgiInfo) );
    }






    IDXGIDevice* dxgiDevice;
    hr = ( (device)->lpVtbl -> QueryInterface(device,&IID_IDXGIDevice,(void**)&dxgiDevice) );
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };

    IDXGIAdapter* dxgiAdapter;
    hr = ( (dxgiDevice)->lpVtbl -> GetAdapter(dxgiDevice,&dxgiAdapter) );
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };

    IDXGIFactory2* factory;
    hr = ( (dxgiAdapter)->lpVtbl -> GetParent(dxgiAdapter,&IID_IDXGIFactory2,(void**)&factory) );
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };

    IDXGIDevice1 *dxgiDevice1;
    hr = ( (device)->lpVtbl -> QueryInterface(device,&IID_IDXGIDevice1,(void**)&dxgiDevice1) );
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };
# 1129 "editor.c"
    swapchain_flags |= DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_ALLOW_TEARING;



    swapchain_flags |= DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_FRAME_LATENCY_WAITABLE_OBJECT;


    DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 desc =
    {




        .Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,



        .SampleDesc = { 1, 0 },
        .BufferUsage = 0x00000020UL | 0x00000400UL,
        .BufferCount = 2,



        .Scaling = DXGI_SCALING_NONE,
        .SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD,
# 1163 "editor.c"
        .Flags = swapchain_flags
    };

    swapchain_flags = swapchain_flags;
    hr = ( (factory)->lpVtbl -> CreateSwapChainForHwnd(factory,(IUnknown*)device,window,&desc,((void*)0),((void*)0),&swapchain) );
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };



    IDXGISwapChain2 *swapchain2;
    hr = ( (swapchain)->lpVtbl -> QueryInterface(swapchain,&IID_IDXGISwapChain2,(void**)&swapchain2) );
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };

    hr = ( (swapchain2)->lpVtbl -> SetMaximumFrameLatency(swapchain2,1) );
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };
    HANDLE waitable_object = ( (swapchain2)->lpVtbl -> GetFrameLatencyWaitableObject(swapchain2) );
# 1187 "editor.c"
    ( (factory)->lpVtbl -> MakeWindowAssociation(factory,window,( 1 << 1 )) );
    ( (factory)->lpVtbl -> Release(factory) );
    ( (dxgiAdapter)->lpVtbl -> Release(dxgiAdapter) );
    ( (dxgiDevice)->lpVtbl -> Release(dxgiDevice) );


    ID3D11ComputeShader *shader;
    hr = ( (device)->lpVtbl -> CreateComputeShader(device,g_shader_cs,(sizeof(g_shader_cs) / sizeof(g_shader_cs[0])),0,&shader) );
    if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };

    ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> CSSetShader(device_context,shader,0,0) );

    arena_t *scratch = arena_alloc((((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024), (((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024));
    loaded_bitmap font_bitmap = load_bitmap("font.bmp", scratch);
    ID3D11ShaderResourceView *font_texture_srv = d3d11_upload_bitmap(font_bitmap);
    arena_reset(scratch);

    ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> CSSetShaderResources(device_context,0,1,&font_texture_srv) );

    ID3D11SamplerState *sampler_state;
    D3D11_SAMPLER_DESC sdesc =
    {
        .Filter = D3D11_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
        .AddressU = D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_CLAMP,
        .AddressV = D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_CLAMP,
        .AddressW = D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_CLAMP,
        .MipLODBias = 0,
        .MaxAnisotropy = 1,
    };
    ( (device)->lpVtbl -> CreateSamplerState(device,&sdesc,&sampler_state) );
    ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> CSSetSamplers(device_context,0,1,&sampler_state) );

    u32 cell_width = 8;
    u32 cell_height = 18;

    D3D11_BUFFER_DESC cbuffer_desc =
    {
        .ByteWidth = (sizeof(cbuffer_t) + 15) / 16 * 16,
        .Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DYNAMIC,
        .BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_CONSTANT_BUFFER,
        .CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_WRITE
    };
    ID3D11Buffer *d3d11_cbuffer;
    ( (device)->lpVtbl -> CreateBuffer(device,&cbuffer_desc,0,&d3d11_cbuffer) );

    ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> CSSetConstantBuffers(device_context,0,1,&d3d11_cbuffer) );

    ID3D11Buffer *cell_buffer;
    ID3D11ShaderResourceView *cell_buffer_srv;

    forever_arena = arena_alloc((((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024), (((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024));
    frame_arena = arena_alloc((((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024), (((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024));

    text_arena = arena_alloc((((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024), (((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024));
    undo_buffer_arena = arena_alloc((((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024), (((u64)(1)) * (u64)1024 * (u64)1024));
    text = win32_read_file("test.txt", &text_size, text_arena);

    spall_end();;

    u64 prev_frame;

    MSG message;
    while(!quit)
    {
        spall_begin("loop");


        spall_begin("waitable object");
        WaitForSingleObjectEx(waitable_object, 0xFFFFFFFF, 1);
        spall_end();;


        u64 time = get_time_us();
        prev_frame = time - frame_start;
        frame_start = time;





        mouse_wheel_delta_accum = 0;
        input_queue_count = 0;

        spall_begin("poll");
        while (PeekMessageA(&message, 0, 0, 0, 0x0001))
        {
            if (message.message == 0x0012)
            {
                quit = 1;
            }

            TranslateMessage(&message);
            DispatchMessageA(&message);
        }
        spall_end();;

        mouse_wheel_delta = (f32) mouse_wheel_delta_accum / 120.0f * 32.0f;
        view_offset_pixels -= mouse_wheel_delta;

        if(screen_w != new_screen_w || screen_h != new_screen_h)
        {
            screen_w = new_screen_w;
            screen_h = new_screen_h;
            resize_swapchain();
        }

        for(u32 i = 0; i < input_queue_count; i++)
        {
            input_event e = input_queue[i];

            if(e.is_down)
            {
                if(e.type == INPUT_EVENT_KEY)
                {

                    {
                        if(e.code == 0x7A)
                        {
                            toggle_fullscreen();
                        }
                        if(e.code == 0xC0)
                        {
                            carets[0] = carets[num_carets - 1];
                            num_carets = 1;
                        }
                    }

                    if(e.code == (0x28 | MODIFIER_ALT | MODIFIER_CTRL))
                    {
                        caret_spawn_new_below();
                    }
                    else if(e.code == (0x26 | MODIFIER_ALT | MODIFIER_CTRL))
                    {
                        caret_spawn_new_above();
                    }
                    else if(e.code == ('Z' | MODIFIER_CTRL))
                    {
                        undo();
                    }
                    else if(e.code == ('Y' | MODIFIER_CTRL))
                    {
                        redo();
                    }
                }
            }

            if(e.type == INPUT_EVENT_TEXT)
            {
                if(e.character > 31 && e.character != '`')
                {
                    text_edit_insert insert =
                    {
                        .strings = arena_push(frame_arena, sizeof(string) * num_carets, 8)
                    };
                    for(u32 j = 0; j < num_carets; j++)
                    {
                        insert.strings[j] = (string)
                        {
                            .p = &e.character,
                            .length = 1
                        };
                    }
                    carets_insert_characters(insert, 1);
                }
                else if(e.character == '\r')
                {
                    char line_end[2] = { '\r', '\n' };
                    text_edit_insert insert =
                    {
                        .strings = arena_push(frame_arena, sizeof(string) * num_carets, 8)
                    };
                    for(u32 j = 0; j < num_carets; j++)
                    {
                        insert.strings[j] = (string)
                        {
                            .p = line_end,
                            .length = 2
                        };
                    }
                    carets_insert_characters(insert, 1);
                }
                else if(e.character == '\b')
                {
                    text_edit_delete delete =
                    {
                        .lengths = arena_push(frame_arena, sizeof(u32) * num_carets, 8)
                    };
                    for(u32 j = 0; j < num_carets; j++)
                    {
                        delete.lengths[j] = 1;
                    }
                    carets_remove_characters(delete, 1);
                }
            }

            for(u32 i = 0; i < num_carets; i++)
            {
                caret *caret = &carets[i];
                if(e.is_down)
                {
                    if(e.type == INPUT_EVENT_KEY)
                    {
                        if(e.code == 0x27)
                        {
                            caret_move_right(caret);
                        }
                        else if(e.code == 0x25)
                        {
                            caret_move_left(caret);
                        }
                        else if(e.code == 0x28)
                        {
                            caret_move_down(caret);
                        }
                        else if(e.code == 0x26)
                        {
                            caret_move_up(caret);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            merge_overlapping_carets_in_a_slow_way();
        }




        u32 width = (screen_w + cell_width - 1) / cell_width;
        u32 height = (screen_h + cell_height - 1) / cell_height + 1;
        u32 cell_count = width * height;

        if(cell_buffer_count < cell_count)
        {
            if(cell_buffer)
            {
                ( (cell_buffer)->lpVtbl -> Release(cell_buffer) );
                ( (cell_buffer_srv)->lpVtbl -> Release(cell_buffer_srv) );
            }

            D3D11_BUFFER_DESC cell_buffer_desc =
            {
                .ByteWidth = cell_count * sizeof(cell),
                .Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DYNAMIC,
                .BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                .CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_WRITE,
                .MiscFlags = D3D11_RESOURCE_MISC_BUFFER_STRUCTURED,
                .StructureByteStride = sizeof(cell)
            };
            ( (device)->lpVtbl -> CreateBuffer(device,&cell_buffer_desc,0,&cell_buffer) );
            D3D11_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC d =
            {
                .Format = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN,
                .ViewDimension = D3D11_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
                .Buffer.NumElements = cell_count,
            };
            ( (device)->lpVtbl -> CreateShaderResourceView(device,(ID3D11Resource*)cell_buffer,&d,&cell_buffer_srv) );
            ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> CSSetShaderResources(device_context,1,1,&cell_buffer_srv) );
            cell_buffer_count = cell_count;
        }

        cell *cells = arena_push(frame_arena, cell_count * sizeof(cell), 64);
        memset(cells, 0, cell_count * sizeof(cell));

        u32 topmost_visible_line = (((0) > (view_offset_pixels / cell_height)) ? (0) : (view_offset_pixels / cell_height));
        u32 text_position = 0;


        {
            u32 line = 0;
            u32 line_start = 0;
            u32 i = 0;
            while(line < topmost_visible_line)
            {
                char c = text[i];
                if(c == '\n')
                {
                    if(i + 1 >= text_size)
                    {
                        break;
                    }
                    line++;
                    line_start = i + 1;
                }
                i++;
                if(i == text_size)
                {
                    break;
                }
            }
            text_position = line_start;
        }

        chopped_line *lines = arena_push(frame_arena, sizeof(chopped_line) * height, 8);
        u32 num_lines = 0;

        u32 column = 0;
        u32 line = 0;
        u32 line_start = text_position;

        while(line < height && text_position < text_size && num_lines < height)
        {
            char c = text[text_position];

            if(c == '\n')
            {
                lines[num_lines] = (chopped_line)
                {
                    .line_in_text = topmost_visible_line + line,
                    .pos_in_text = line_start,
                    .length = text_position - line_start,
                };
                line_start = text_position + 1;
                num_lines++;
                line++;
                column = 0;
            }
            else
            {
                if(text_position - line_start >= width - 1 && c > 31)
                {
                    lines[num_lines] = (chopped_line)
                    {
                        .line_in_text = topmost_visible_line + line,
                        .pos_in_text = line_start,
                        .length = text_position - line_start,
                    };
                    line_start = text_position;
                    num_lines++;
                }

                if(c != '\r')
                {
                    column++;
                }
            }

            text_position++;
        }

        b32 caret_blink = 0;
        u32 caret_period = 1000 * 1000;
        if((time - caret_last_move_time) % caret_period > caret_period / 2)
        {
            caret_blink = 1;
        }

        for(u32 i = 0; i < num_lines; i++)
        {
            chopped_line *l = &lines[i];
            for(u32 j = 0; j < (((l->length) < (width)) ? (l->length) : (width)); j++)
            {
                char c = text[l->pos_in_text + j];
                u32 cell_index = j + i * width;
                u32 text_color = 0x00FFFFFF;
                u32 bg_color = 0x00000000;

                cells[cell_index] = (cell)
                {
                    .atlas_index = c - 33,
                    .text_color = text_color,
                    .bg_color = bg_color,
                };
            }

            for(u32 k = 0; k < num_carets; k++)
            {
                caret *caret = &carets[k];
                if(caret->position >= l->pos_in_text && caret->position < l->pos_in_text + l->length)
                {
                    for(u32 j = 0; j < width; j++)
                    {
                        cells[i * width + j].bg_color = 0x001F1F1F;
                    }
                }
            }

            for(u32 k = 0; k < num_carets; k++)
            {
                caret *caret = &carets[k];
                if(caret->position >= l->pos_in_text && caret->position < l->pos_in_text + l->length)
                {
                    if(!caret_blink)
                    {
                        cell *c = &cells[caret->position - l->pos_in_text + i * width];
                        c->bg_color = ~c->bg_color;
                        c->text_color = ~c->text_color;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        u32 view_offset_cell = view_offset_pixels < 0.0f ? view_offset_pixels : (i32)view_offset_pixels % cell_height;

        cbuffer_t cb =
        {
            .cell_width = cell_width,
            .cell_height = cell_height,
            .num_cells_x = width,
            .num_cells_y = height,
            .atlas_width_characters_x = 14,
            .atlas_height_characters_y = 7,
            .view_offset_pixels = view_offset_cell,
            .vsync_line_position = get_time_us() / 1000 % screen_w,
            .pointer_x = mouse_x,
            .pointer_y = mouse_y
        };

        spall_begin("draw");
        d3d11_write_buffer((ID3D11Resource*)cell_buffer, cells, cell_count * sizeof(cell));
        d3d11_write_buffer((ID3D11Resource*)d3d11_cbuffer, &cb, sizeof(cbuffer_t));

        ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> Dispatch(device_context,(screen_w + 8 - 1) / 8,(screen_h + 8 - 1) / 8,1) );
        spall_end();;




        spall_begin("present");
        hr = ( (swapchain)->lpVtbl -> Present(swapchain,0,0x00000200UL) );
        if(!((((HRESULT)(hr)) >= 0))) { *(volatile int*)0 = 0; };

        ( (device_context)->lpVtbl -> CSSetUnorderedAccessViews(device_context,0,1,&uav,0) );

        if(frame_count == 0)
        {
            ShowWindow(window, 5);
        }
        spall_end();;

        frame_count++;
        arena_reset(frame_arena);

        spall_end();;
    }

    spall_end_profiling();

    ExitProcess(0);
}
